hero_title: Bridging India's Healthcare Divide with Intelligent Triage
hero_desc: From high-bandwidth district hospitals to zero-connectivity Primary Health Centres (PHCs), SAHAYAK-Triage structures vernacular voice notes, lab reports, and body-map inputs into deterministic, safety-first triage records for qualified human review.
problem_heading: The Challenge in India's Healthcare System
problem_sub: Serving 1.4+ billion citizens across diverse terrains, languages, and digital connectivity levels.
prob_1_desc: High patient volumes with ratio exceeding 1 doctor per 1,500+ patients in rural areas leading to long wait times and delayed urgent care.
prob_2_desc: 22 scheduled languages and hundreds of local dialects make clinical symptom articulation difficult in centralized digital systems.
prob_3_desc: Healthcare facilities range from optic-fiber district hospitals to remote health camps with zero grid power or 2G mobile internet.
prob_4_desc: Lack of structured transfer notes and immediate triage flags delays critical patient escalation to tertiary care centres.
solution_sub: A lightweight, multimodal web platform designed for every tier of India's healthcare referral chain.
sol_1_desc: YAML-driven clinical rules decide urgency (RED / AMBER / GREEN) BEFORE any LLM is called, eliminating AI hallucination risks.
sol_2_desc: Captures vernacular voice notes (faster-whisper), photographs of lab reports (Tesseract OCR), text, and visual touch body maps.
sol_3_desc: Local SQLite caching with quantized offline models continues triage with zero internet and auto-syncs when online.
sol_4_desc: Doctors & Nurses cross-examine original lab photos against extracted values, accept/edit/override, and generate 1-click QR referrals.
step_1_desc: Patient or ASHA worker inputs symptoms via Voice, Text, Body Map, or Lab Report photo without needing an account.
step_2_desc: OCR reads lab values (SpO2, BP, Hb), Whisper transcribes audio, and translation normalizes vernacular phrases.
step_3_desc: YAML safety rules immediately flag emergency cases (RED) or priority cases (AMBER) with explicit evidence.
step_4_desc: Medical Officers verify evidence, review AI advisory questions, sign off on notes, or trigger instant referrals.
consent_body: By proceeding, you agree to share symptom information for triage and queue prioritization. This system is strictly non-diagnostic and assists healthcare staff in organizing your care. All synthetic data is handled under minimal retention policies.
cannot_collect: We cannot proceed without your consent to collect data.
